title: Static memory/cache evidence checkpoint; preparatory, not default selection

definitions.allocation_count: Number of requested C++ heap allocations in the constructor ROI; allocator hooks, never clean timing.
definitions.requested_bytes: Sum of requested C++ payload bytes over the ROI, not retained/live bytes; excludes allocator metadata, direct malloc and tracker overhead.
definitions.extra_peak: Maximum tracked live C++ payload during ROI minus entry live payload; caller Vector materialization already exists. Not total working set or index-only retention.
definitions.known_retained: Reported capacity metadata/object bytes, including generator objects but excluding opaque Vector heap payload and allocator overhead. Lazy measurements have POSETS_LAZY_KDTREE_STATS=1; object/policy fields changed. Do not call these exact shipping sizeof totals.
definitions.cachegrind: Cold simulated I1=32768B/8-way,D1=49152B/12-way,LL=25165824B/12-way,64B lines; ignores actualL2; portable generic O3,noLTO. Data totals here add read+write misses.
definitions.hardware_pmu: Native-compatible128 O3/LTO,CPU2,user-only build0. Includes Vector materialization+constructor; parser/validation/final destruction excluded. Natural cache state after preceding process work, no cold flush.24 event groups/96 reads all running fraction1, no scaled counts.
definitions.pmu_estimators: Table uses separate before/final medians; three exact paired ratios remain in F. Separate-median ratio differs from median paired ratio; neither supplies significance from three samples.
definitions.cgroup: Scope memory.peak would include parser/oracle/children and is not an index-retention or selected-PMU-ROI metric. These selected small summaries do not provide comparable per-row cgroup peak values; none is invented here.8GiB/no-swap is an enforced limit, not observed usage.

limitations: Static preparatory checkpoint only: no new build, test, profile, timing or full raw scan; no default/backend recommendation.
Pinned artifact comparisons are historical d139->a027 or d139->cc, not later compiler-context repair results or an end-to-end Acacia solver claim.
I records remaining workload-dependent regressions; do not relabel all of them compiler noise. Constructor versus second independent build versus in-place maintenance are distinct.

Final cc synthetic grid policy control: forced bulkN16384 median100.796ms versus indexed80.656ms; N4096 bulk6.221ms versus indexed7.407ms. Memory/capacity savings do not imply universal CPU gains or a larger default cutoff.
The full-arbiter construction input is validated actual-contains trace7; source-unverified full-arbiter CPre is excluded. Held-out data is not consulted.
